detached_structure.evidence: A gray-roofed building to the lower right of the central house, separated by trees, appears to be a detached structure. It may belong to the neighboring lot.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray hip-style roof, a rear deck with patio umbrellas, and a narrow driveway running along its left side. Heavy tree canopy covers the east and south sides of the lot, and the lot boundaries are unclear.
